Comment.value: Pale Master initiation reagent (roadmap: pale-master-quest). Taken from the unmarked sarcophagus in the Bree Crypt Lower Level (q_pal_tomb OnOpen); the design card's GetItemPossessedBy check at Halmir's turn-in (q_pal_c_rdy). Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded; q_pal_finish clears the plot flag and consumes it.

value.0: A measure of pale grave-dust in a small glass phial, taken with your own hands from the one tomb beneath Bree that carries no name. It weighs almost nothing, and the phial is always cold. Halmir the Grey asked that it be carried to him unspilled.
